text:
marta (People Ops): Leaving this thread from the allhands for quick followups on leveling / comp / promo timing. Keep it short & well answer live. If it's private, DM People Ops.

leah (PM): quick one  will calibration outcomes land before managers need to announce to ICs? want to coordinate team 1:1s.

jay (People Ops Lead): Yes - managers get notification 24 hours before the general email. We aim to keep a short lead so teams can sync. If you need more time to prep messaging, DM me and we can shift by exception.

zach (Eng): my manager is out for two weeks. I submitted selfeval but worried the packet will be incomplete. what should I expect?

marta (People Ops): We flag missing manager feedback and pull in peer notes + your selfeval. If the panel needs more context we either reach out to the manager or ask you for a 1-paragraph addendum. It won't auto-block.

george (Finance): FYI on comp timing: once approvals are in HRIS, payroll picks them up in the next run. Most folks see changes within 1-2 pay cycles. Retro backpay = single line item on the paycheck.

zach (Eng): if promo paperwork is signed late but effective earlier, can bonuses be recalculated?

george (Finance): yes, bonuses are based on effective date in the system. If the effective date falls in the bonus window we will recalc pro rata. Send me a note with employee name and dates and I'll run a scenario.

leah (PM): is there a standard template for the "manager absent" addendum? trying to make it quick for my team to fill out.

marta (People Ops): Yup  here's a onepage template we prefer (paste into your packet):

```- Role & current band
- Proposed band/level and effective date
- 23 bullet examples of impact (metric or customer outcome + quarter)
- Optional: any blockers or dependencies to leveling decision
```

marta (People Ops): Post in this thread or DM me and we will attach it to the calibration packet so the panel sees it.

zach (Eng): appeals process? timeline?

jay (People Ops Lead): You have 7 calendar days from the notification email to submit an appeal. Include specific evidence (examples, dates, links to PRs or docs). Appeals are reviewed by a crossfunctional panel; we surface missed evidence but not guaranteed upgrades.

leah (PM): small benefits Q  is the commuter benefit going to change for 2026? heard something in allhands.

benefits-bot: Reminder: benefits survey closes Friday. Input affects small plan tweaks like commuter stipend.

marta (People Ops): No substantive commuter plan change approved yet. Were collecting feedback this week and will publish any changes in the benefits update next Tuesday.

zach (Eng): can you also share a simple flow of "what happens after manager hits approve"? dev team finds the timing opaque.

marta (People Ops): Sure  quick flow: manager approves -> People Ops validates packet -> calibration committee meets (if applicable) -> HRIS updated with effective date -> payroll picks up changes (1-2 cycles) -> notification emails sent. Ill drop a visual in the people ops doc later today.

leah (PM): small ask  if a manager forgets to submit on time, can we change the effective date retroactively?

george (Finance): We can backdate promotions for administrative delays; we treat on casebycase for payroll and bonus calculations. DM with specifics and we'll confirm timelines.

marta (People Ops): Office hours tomorrow 1011:30am PT for anyone who wants to run through packets. If you want a 1:1 slot outside that, reply here with availability.

marta (People Ops): Final note  we put a short FAQ + the addendum template here: https://redwood-internal.docs/peopleops/quickcompfaq (permissions: all employees). Thanks all!
